title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.02204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Building reliable robot capabilities across diverse tasks requires substantial human effort to develop and maintain skills, design rewards, and integrate perception with control. We present Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG), a framework for autonomous improvement of robot execution systems without updating model weights. RPG identifies manipulation capabilities in an offline dataset and constructs related practice tasks in simulation. During practice, RPG uses execution feedback, privileged simulator state, and available dataset videos to diagnose failures. It develops new reusable symbolic skills, refines existing skills, and revises the system prompt based on these diagnoses. Cross-task evaluation tests individual candidate changes and merged revisions before they are retained for reuse. At test time, a multimodal LLM uses the resulting system prompt and skill library to coordinate perception and robot control. On held-out initial

translated_title: 重建、练习、走向现实：具身智能体的引导式自我改进
translated_abstract: 构建跨多种任务的可靠机器人能力需要大量人力来开发和维护技能、设计奖励以及将感知与控制相集成。我们提出了 Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real（RPG），这是一个无需更新模型权重即可自主改进机器人执行系统的框架。RPG 在离线数据集中识别操作能力，并在仿真中构建相关的练习任务。在练习过程中，RPG 利用执行反馈、特权仿真器状态以及可用的数据集视频来诊断失败原因。基于这些诊断，它会开发新的可复用符号技能、改进现有技能，并修订系统提示词。跨任务评估会对单个候选更改以及合并后的修订版本进行测试，通过后才会被保留以供复用。在测试阶段，多模态大语言模型使用由此生成的系统提示词和技能库来协调感知与机器人控制。
tldr: 提出RPG框架，通过在仿真中重建练习任务、利用执行反馈与仿真状态诊断失败，进而自动改进技能库和系统提示词，实现无需更新模型权重的机器人执行系统自主自我提升。
en_tdlr: RPG is a framework that enables autonomous self-improvement of robot execution systems without updating model weights, by reconstructing practice tasks in simulation, diagnosing failures using execution feedback and privileged simulator state, and iteratively refining a reusable skill library and system prompt.
